sv.title: Få vinnare i Europa – Nokia faller tungt
sv.summary: De ledande Europabörserna hade en sur utveckling med få vinnare i förmiddagshandeln på tisdagen, efter teknikdrivna nedgångar i USA och Asien. Ledande Europabörser var alla ned mellan 0,9–1,1 procent omkring klockan 10.25.

en.title: Few winners in Europe – Nokia falls sharply
en.summary: Leading European exchanges had a sour performance with few winners in morning trade on Tuesday, after tech-driven declines in the US and Asia. Leading European exchanges were all down between 0.9–1.1 percent at around 10.25 a.m.
